So on price, rating, shipping, returns, and warranty — which are the normal reasons to prefer one seller over another — they are identical in these listings. There's no evidence-based reason to choose one over the other from what is shown.

If you want a tie-breaker, you'd need to look outside these two pages - e.g., your prior experience with either seller, independent seller reputation, or payment protections.
